options.name: accountId
options.description: Account ID. Please declare at least one of the two arguments, accountId or configId.

options.name: configId
options.description: The ID of a Flex VM Configuration. Please declare at least one of the two arguments, accountId or configId.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to authenticate. If not declared, the code will read the environment variable FORTIFLEX_ACCESS_PASSWORD.

options.name: status
options.description: Filter option. A list. Possible values are "ACTIVE", "PENDDING", "STOPPED" and "EXPIRED".

options.name: username
options.description: The username to authenticate. If not declared, the code will read the environment variable FORTIFLEX_ACCESS_USERNAME.
